job.title: Frontend UI Developer (Angular)
job.description: FinServe Technologies in Mumbai is looking for an Angular Developer to join our banking platform team. Responsibilities include building secure client dashboards using Angular 16+, RxJS, TypeScript, and Angular Material. Understanding of reactive forms, guards, and HTTP interceptors is required.

pool.text: Angular 16+: developed modular components, lazy-loaded routes, and route guards
RxJS operators: mastered switchMap, debounceTime, combineLatest for reactive search streams
Angular Material: customized themes, tables, dialogs, and paginators to match brand spec
TypeScript: strict type safety, generics, interfaces, and enums for financial payloads
SecureBankUI: simulated retail banking portal with fund transfer flow, OTP mock, and statement export
Angular HTTP Interceptor: implemented JWT token attaching and global 401 error redirect handling
Docker Swarm: deployed multi-node microservices swarm cluster
Frontend Intern at FinEdge (Mumbai, 6 months): maintained customer loan application wizard in Angular
Python Flask API: built quick mockup backend with SQLite database
Jasmine & Karma: wrote unit tests for Angular services and reactive form validators
Solidity: wrote ERC-20 smart contract on Ethereum testnet
